title: Cross-project wins: xgboost_brier NBA port, S22 engine audit, Lightning injection gate

proposals.title: Port xgboost_brier objective to NBA island mutation pool

evidence.conclusion: xgboost_brier achieves equivalent performance 17x faster. Applies to NBA: direct Brier minimization should outperform log-loss proxy on calibrated tree ensembles.

implementation.change: In MODEL_CONFIG or ALLOWED_MODELS dict, add entry: {"model_type": "xgboost_brier", "params": {"objective": "binary:logistic", "eval_metric": "logloss", "max_depth": 6, "learning_rate": 0.1}}
implementation.note: NBA islands S13/S14/S18 use extra_trees/random_forest. Adding xgboost_brier to mutation pool adds diversity without disrupting existing champions.

proposals.title: Investigate and fix S22 (TESTforge42/nba-evo-s22) engine misconfiguration

evidence.conclusion: S22 appears to be running political engine (272f) instead of NBA engine (3377f). Brier in political range confirms this.

investigation_steps: 1. Check S22 Space app.py: grep for NBA_DATA_PATH or POLITICAL_DATA_PATH env var
2. Check HF Space environment variables: HUGGINGFACE_HUB or Space Settings > Variables
3. Compare S22 app.py against S18 app.py (both TESTforge42 account) — S18 works correctly (brier=0.22027)
4. Likely fix: update S22 Space env or app.py to point to NBA data file (nba_cached_data.npz or equivalent)
5. After fix: restart Space, verify feature_candidates ~3377 and brier drops to 0.22x range
proposals.impact: S22 slot currently wasted (running political GA with political brier target on NBA slots). Fix restores full 6-island NBA fleet coverage.

proposals.title: Gate Lightning.ai elite injection at island_eval_brier < current_island_best

evidence.observation: P7 received karpathy_lightning_0.20238 elite injection. Island re-evaluated at 0.25412. Lightning's reported 0.20238 (in-sample or different split) did not generalize.
evidence.risk: Noisy elite injections can corrupt island population, wasting compute cycles on overfit models

proposed_fix.change: Before injecting Lightning elite into island, call /api/status on target island, compare reported best_brier. Only inject if lightning_eval_brier (re-evaluated with island's own data split) < island_best_brier.
proposed_fix.fallback: If island has no /api/inject endpoint, log the candidate to data/research-proposals/lightning-elites/ for manual review instead of auto-injecting.

proposals.note: Existing 2026-04-23-04h-karpathy-lightning-bridge.json proposal covers the bridge mechanism. This is a targeted quality gate for the injection step.

proposals.title: S17 stagnation early-warning: pre-load diversify candidates for next cycle
proposals.action: At next cycle, if S17 stagnation>=15, POST https://lbjlincoln26-nba-evo-s17.hf.space/api/command {"action": "diversify"}. S17's extra_trees population has been locked at 51 features for 1438+ cycles — diversify should inject random_forest and xgboost_brier variants.
